courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 隧道岩栓拉拔驗證
related.transfer: 可遷移「裂後承載與纖維橋接」與「荷重位移同步與零點」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging" and "Force-displacement synchronization and zero" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土；隧道岩栓拉拔驗證則以辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction; Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification centres on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裂後承載與纖維橋接」與「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道岩栓拉拔驗證，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「持載位移與時間效應」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” and “Wedge weight and bolt direction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Hold movement and time effects", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” and “Rib spacing and tributary width”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗
history.text: 本課討論的以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「裂後承載與纖維橋接」到「性能規格與試法交接」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging" through "Performance specifications and method handover" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
